key.name: mode
key.description: "tap-to-toggle" starts and stops recording with one press each; "push-to-hold" records while the key is held.

key.name: hotkey
key.description: The evdev key name or modifier chord (for example CTRL+KEY_F13) that triggers dictation outside Flatpak.

key.name: portal-shortcut-enabled
key.description: Re-register the approved GlobalShortcuts portal shortcut when the app restarts (Flatpak).

key.name: language
key.description: The spoken language, or "auto" to detect it. First run seeds it from the system locale.

key.name: translate
key.description: Transcribe speech in any language as English text.

key.name: model
key.description: The whisper model used for transcription. Larger models are more accurate, slower and bigger to download.

key.name: device
key.description: Where transcription runs; "auto" picks the fastest measured device for the model.

key.name: mic-source
key.description: The capture device, or "auto" for the system default.

key.name: vad
key.description: Use whisper.cpp's voice activity detection to drop silence, which otherwise transcribes as words such as "you". A buffer judged silent is retried untrimmed when it was loud.

key.name: launch-at-login
key.description: Start Quoth in the background when you log in.

key.name: keep-warm
key.description: Keep the model in memory between dictations for a faster response.

key.name: keep-warm-timeout
key.description: Idle seconds before the loaded model is freed.

key.name: sound-feedback
key.description: Play recording cues; "auto" plays them when there is no on-screen overlay.

key.name: notification-feedback
key.description: Show recording notifications; "auto" shows them when there is no on-screen overlay.

key.name: sound-volume
key.description: Loudness of the recording cues, from 0 to 100.

key.name: notify-updates
key.description: Check the latest release at startup and notify. Nothing is downloaded or installed.

key.name: crash-reports
key.description: Send technical details about errors and crashes to Sentry (EU). Never audio or dictated text.

key.name: onboarding-complete
key.description: Set when onboarding completes, so it is shown only once.

key.name: calibration-offered
key.description: Set once the device benchmark has been offered, so the offer is shown only once.

key.name: overlay-style
key.description: The recording overlay: the "pill" or the experimental audio-reactive "orb".
